segments.tr: وقد يعكس بعضه قيام الناس بسحب المدخرات أو الاعتماد على الائتمان لمواكبة الأسعار المرتفعة.

segments.src: ### AI-Related Investment
segments.tr: ### الاستثمار المتعلق بالذكاء الاصطناعي

segments.src: Business investment has drawn particular attention because of heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
segments.tr: جذب استثمار الأعمال اهتماماً خاصاً بسبب الإنفاق الضخم على البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: Data centers, computing hardware, software and the power and construction work that support them all count as investment in GDP.
segments.tr: تُعد مراكز البيانات وأجهزة الحوسبة والبرمجيات وأعمال الطاقة والبناء التي تدعمها جميعاً استثماراً في الناتج المحلي الإجمالي.

segments.src: This spending can lift the headline figure noticeably.
segments.tr: يمكن لهذا الإنفاق أن يرفع الرقم الرئيسي بشكل ملحوظ.

segments.src: It is also concentrated in a relatively small number of companies and industries.
segments.tr: كما أنه يتركز في عدد صغير نسبياً من الشركات والصناعات.

segments.src: A boom in server and data-center building can raise GDP without immediately changing the experience of a typical worker or renter.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي ازدهار بناء الخوادم ومراكز البيانات إلى رفع الناتج المحلي الإجمالي دون تغيير تجربة العامل أو المستأجر العادي على الفور.

segments.src: ### Trade
segments.tr: ### التجارة

segments.src: Net exports are one of the more volatile pieces of the report.
segments.tr: صافي الصادرات هو أحد أكثر أجزاء التقرير تقلباً.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP and exports add to it.
segments.tr: تطرح الواردات من الناتج المحلي الإجمالي وتضيف الصادرات إليه.

segments.src: Swings in shipping, tariffs, inventory decisions and timing can move this component sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي التقلبات في الشحن والتعريفات الجمركية وقرارات المخزون والتوقيت إلى تحريك هذا المكون بشكل حاد من ربع إلى آخر.

segments.src: A big shift in trade can make the headline number look stronger or weaker than the underlying demand.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يجعل التحول الكبير في التجارة الرقم الرئيسي يبدو أقوى أو أضعف من الطلب الأساسي.

segments.src: For that reason, many economists also watch measures that strip out trade and inventories to get a cleaner read on domestic demand.
segments.tr: ولهذا السبب، يراقب العديد من الاقتصاديين أيضاً المقاييس التي تستبعد التجارة والمخزونات للحصول على قراءة أوضح للطلب المحلي.

segments.src: ### Government and Inventories
segments.tr: ### الحكومة والمخزونات

segments.src: Government spending and changes in business inventories also contribute.
segments.tr: يساهم الإنفاق الحكومي والتغيرات في مخزونات الأعمال أيضاً.

segments.src: Inventory swings in particular tend to reverse, so they can flatter one quarter and drag on the next.
segments.tr: تميل تقلبات المخزون على وجه الخصوص إلى الانعكاس، لذا يمكن أن تجمل ربعاً وتثقل كاهل الربع التالي.

segments.src: ## Why It Can Still Feel Slower
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد لا يزال يبدو أبطأ

segments.src: If output is rising at a healthy clip, why do so many people feel stuck?
segments.tr: إذا كان الإنتاج يرتفع بوتيرة صحية، فلماذا يشعر الكثير من الناس بأنهم عالقون؟

segments.src: Several explanations are commonly offered by economists.
segments.tr: هناك عدة تفسيرات يقدمها الاقتصاديون عادةً.

segments.src: Prices rise even when inflation cools.** Inflation measures how fast prices increase.
segments.tr: ترتفع الأسعار حتى عندما يبرد التضخم.** يقيس التضخم مدى سرعة ارتفاع الأسعار.

segments.src: A slowing rate does not mean prices fall.
segments.tr: تباطؤ المعدل لا يعني انخفاض الأسعار.

segments.src: If the cost of food, housing or insurance jumped in earlier years, those higher levels remain.
segments.tr: إذا قفزت تكلفة الغذاء أو السكن أو التأمين في السنوات السابقة، فإن تلك المستويات الأعلى تظل قائمة.

segments.src: Households tend to judge the economy by the prices they see now, not by the pace of change.
segments.tr: تميل الأسر إلى الحكم على الاقتصاد من خلال الأسعار التي تراها الآن، وليس من خلال وتيرة التغيير.

segments.src: Essentials weigh more than averages suggest.** Official inflation gauges average across many goods.
segments.tr: الأساسيات تزن أكثر مما تشير إليه المتوسطات.** تقيس مقاييس التضخم الرسمية المتوسط عبر العديد من السلع.

segments.src: A household that spends a large share of its income on rent, groceries, childcare or health care may experience its own inflation rate as higher than the average.
segments.tr: قد تعاني الأسرة التي تنفق جزءاً كبيراً من دخلها على الإيجار أو البقالة أو رعاية الأطفال أو الرعاية الصحية من معدل تضخم خاص بها أعلى من المتوسط.

segments.src: Borrowing remains expensive.** Even if interest rates have eased from their peaks, mortgage, auto and credit-card costs can be well above where they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: لا يزال الاقتراض مكلفاً.** حتى لو انخفضت أسعار الفائدة عن ذروتها، يمكن أن تكون تكاليف الرهن العقاري والسيارات وبطاقات الائتمان أعلى بكثير مما كانت عليه قبل بضع سنوات.

segments.src: That limits what many households can afford, whatever the national growth rate says.
segments.tr: وهذا يحد مما يمكن للعديد من الأسر تحمله، بغض النظر عما يقوله معدل النمو الوطني.

segments.src: Growth is not evenly shared.** An economy can expand while gains flow mostly to business owners, investors and higher earners.
segments.tr: النمو ليس مشتركاً بالتساوي.** يمكن أن يتوسع الاقتصاد بينما تتدفق المكاسب في الغالب إلى أصحاب الأعمال والمستثمرين وأصحاب الدخل المرتفع.

segments.src: Wage growth that merely keeps pace with prices leaves little sense of progress.
segments.tr: نمو الأجور الذي يواكب الأسعار فقط لا يترك سوى القليل من الشعور بالتقدم.

segments.src: Jobs and confidence are separate from output.** Growth can be strong while hiring slows or workers worry about job security.
segments.tr: الوظائف والثقة منفصلة عن الإنتاج.** يمكن أن يكون النمو قوياً بينما يتباطأ التوظيف أو يقلق العمال بشأن الأمن الوظيفي.

segments.src: Perceptions of the labor market often shape sentiment more than GDP does.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تشكل تصورات سوق العمل المشاعر أكثر مما يفعله الناتج المحلي الإجمالي.

segments.src: GDP is not a measure of well-being.** It counts production, not savings, debt, housing affordability or financial stress.
segments.tr: الناتج المحلي الإجمالي ليس مقياساً للرفاهية.** فهو يحسب الإنتاج، وليس المدخرات أو الديون أو القدرة على تحمل تكاليف السكن أو الضغوط المالية.

segments.src: A country can post strong GDP while many individuals feel squeezed.
segments.tr: يمكن لبلد ما أن يسجل ناتجاً محلياً إجمالياً قوياً بينما يشعر العديد من الأفراد بالضيق.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: A single quarter does not settle the question.
segments.tr: ربع واحد لا يحسم المسألة.

segments.src: These indicators can help put the 3.4% figure in context:
segments.tr: يمكن لهذه المؤشرات أن تساعد في وضع رقم 3.4% في سياقه:

segments.src: - **Revisions to the GDP estimate**, which can change the story.
segments.tr: - **مراجعات تقدير الناتج المحلي الإجمالي**، والتي يمكن أن تغير القصة.

segments.src: - **Real disposable income**, meaning income after taxes and inflation, which says more about household capacity than GDP does.
segments.tr: - **الدخل الحقيقي المتاح**، أي الدخل بعد الضرائب والتضخم، والذي يخبرنا عن قدرة الأسرة أكثر مما يفعله الناتج المحلي الإجمالي.

segments.src: - **Wage growth compared with price growth**, since the gap between the two determines whether paychecks stretch further.
segments.tr: - **نمو الأجور مقارنة بنمو الأسعار**، حيث أن الفجوة بينهما تحدد ما إذا كانت الرواتب تمتد أكثر.

segments.src: - **Labor market data**, including hiring, unemployment and job openings.
segments.tr: - **بيانات سوق العمل**، بما في ذلك التوظيف والبطالة وفرص العمل.

segments.src: - **Business investment outside the AI sector**, to see whether growth is broad or narrow.
segments.tr: - **استثمار الأعمال خارج قطاع الذكاء الاصطناعي**، لمعرفة ما إذا كان النمو واسعاً أم ضيقاً.

segments.src: - **Consumer sentiment surveys**, which capture how people feel, not only what they spend.
segments.tr: - **استطلاعات ثقة المستهلك**، التي تلتقط كيف يشعر الناس، وليس فقط ما ينفقونه.

segments.src: ## A Practical Takeaway for Households
segments.tr: ## نصيحة عملية للأسر

segments.src: National statistics are useful for understanding the economy's direction.
segments.tr: الإحصاءات الوطنية مفيدة لفهم اتجاه الاقتصاد.

segments.src: They are a poor guide to your own situation.
segments.tr: وهي دليل ضعيف على وضعك الخاص.

segments.src: A few general habits can help you separate the headlines from your own finances:
segments.tr: يمكن لبعض العادات العامة أن تساعدك على فصل العناوين الرئيسية عن أموالك الخاصة:

segments.src: - Track your own budget, especially the categories that have risen fastest.
segments.tr: - تتبع ميزانيتك الخاصة، وخاصة الفئات التي ارتفعت بشكل أسرع.

segments.src: - Compare your income growth with the prices you actually pay.
segments.tr: - قارن نمو دخلك بالأسعار التي تدفعها فعلياً.

segments.src: - Review variable-rate debt and think about what a change in rates would mean for you.
segments.tr: - راجع الديون ذات الفائدة المتغيرة وفكر فيما قد يعنيه تغيير أسعار الفائدة بالنسبة لك.

segments.src: - Keep an emergency cushion if you can, since a strong economy does not guarantee job stability.
segments.tr: - احتفظ بمدخرات طوارئ إذا استطعت، لأن الاقتصاد القوي لا يضمن الاستقرار الوظيفي.

segments.src: - Treat any single data release as one data point, not a forecast.
segments.tr: - تعامل مع أي إصدار بيانات واحد كنقطة بيانات واحدة، وليس كتوقعات.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: A 3.4% annualized growth rate points to an economy with real momentum, helped by consumer spending, heavy AI-related investment and shifts in trade.
segments.tr: يشير معدل النمو السنوي البالغ 3.4% إلى اقتصاد يتمتع بزخم حقيقي، مدعوماً بإنفاق المستهلكين، والاستثمار الضخم المتعلق بالذكاء الاصطناعي، والتحولات في التجارة.

segments.src: But GDP measures total output.
segments.tr: لكن الناتج المحلي الإجمالي يقيس إجمالي الإنتاج.

segments.src: It does not measure how comfortable families feel after paying for housing, food and debt.
segments.tr: وهو لا يقيس مدى شعور العائلات بالراحة بعد دفع تكاليف السكن والغذاء والديون.

segments.src: The gap between a strong headline and a tight household budget is not a contradiction.
segments.tr: الفجوة بين العنوان الرئيسي القوي وميزانية الأسرة الضيقة ليست تناقضاً.

segments.src: It reflects the difference between how much an economy produces and how that production, and the price of living, show up in daily life.
segments.tr: بل تعكس الفرق بين مقدار ما ينتجه الاقتصاد وكيف يظهر هذا الإنتاج، وتكلفة المعيشة، في الحياة اليومية.

segments.src: *Figures cited reflect the initial third-quarter estimate and may be revised.
segments.tr: *الأرقام المذكورة تعكس التقدير الأولي للربع الثالث وقد تخضع للمراجعة.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources, such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis, for the latest data.*
segments.tr: يجب على القراء مراجعة المصادر الرسمية، مثل مكتب التحليل الاقتصادي، للحصول على أحدث البيانات.*

fr.title: Croissance de 3,4 %, alors pourquoi cela semble-t-il plus lent ? Lecture du rapport sur le PIB du troisième trimestre

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: L'

segments.src: economy grew at a 3.4% annualized rate in the third quarter, up from 2.2% in the second.
segments.tr: économie américaine a progressé à un rythme annualisé de 3,4 % au troisième trimestre, contre 2,2 % au deuxième.

segments.src: By the usual yardsticks, that is a solid number.
segments.tr: Selon les critères habituels, c'est un chiffre solide.

segments.src: Yet plenty of households say they feel no stronger, because grocery bills, rent, insurance and borrowing costs still weigh on their budgets.
segments.tr: Pourtant, de nombreux ménages affirment ne se sentir pas plus à l'aise, car les factures d'épicerie, le loyer, l'assurance et les coûts d'emprunt pèsent toujours sur leur budget.

segments.src: Both things can be true.
segments.tr: Les deux peuvent être vrais.

segments.src: GDP and a family's finances measure different things.
segments.tr: Le PIB et les finances d'une famille mesurent des choses différentes.

segments.src: This article looks at what the headline figure captures, what tends to drive it, and why it can diverge from everyday experience.
segments.tr: Cet article examine ce que le chiffre principal capture, ce qui tend à le stimuler et pourquoi il peut diverger de l'expérience quotidienne.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Cet article est uniquement destiné à des informations générales.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: Il ne constitue pas un conseil en investissement, fiscal ou financier.*

segments.src: ## What the 3.4% Actually Means
segments.tr: ## Ce que signifie réellement le 3,4 %

segments.src: Gross domestic product is the total value of goods and services produced in the country over a period.
segments.tr: Le produit intérieur brut est la valeur totale des biens et services produits dans le pays sur une période.

segments.src: Government statisticians report the quarterly change as an **annualized** rate.
segments.tr: Les statisticiens du gouvernement signalent la variation trimestrielle sous forme de taux **annualisé**.

segments.src: That is the pace the economy would reach if the quarter's growth continued for a full year.
segments.tr: C'est le rythme que l'économie atteindrait si la croissance du trimestre se poursuivait pendant toute une année.

segments.src: A 3.4% reading does not mean the economy grew 3.4% in three months.
segments.tr: Une lecture de 3,4 % ne signifie pas que l'économie a grandi de 3,4 % en trois mois.

segments.src: It means it expanded at a pace that, sustained, would add up to 3.4% over twelve months.
segments.tr: Cela signifie qu'elle s'est développée à un rythme qui, s'il était soutenu, atteindrait 3,4 % sur douze mois.

segments.src: Three features of the figure matter for interpretation:
segments.tr: Trois caractéristiques du chiffre comptent pour l'interprétation :

segments.src: - **It is an early estimate.** The first reading is based on incomplete data and is usually revised as more information arrives. Revisions can be meaningful.
segments.tr: - **Il s'agit d'une estimation préliminaire.** La première lecture est basée sur des données incomplètes et est généralement révisée à mesure que de plus amples informations arrivent. Les révisions peuvent être significatives.

segments.src: - **It is adjusted for inflation.** The headline is "real" GDP. It strips out price changes to show changes in output.
segments.tr: - **Il est ajusté pour l'inflation.** Le titre est le PIB "réel". Il élimine les variations de prix pour montrer les variations de la production.

segments.src: - **It is an aggregate.** It tells you how big the total pie grew. It does not tell you who got the larger slices.
segments.tr: - **C'est un agrégat.** Il vous indique à quel point le gâteau total a poussé. Il ne vous dit pas qui a obtenu les plus grosses parts.

segments.src: The acceleration from 2.2% to 3.4% suggests momentum improved.
segments.tr: L'accélération de 2,2 % à 3,4 % suggère que la dynamique s'est améliorée.

segments.src: Quarterly figures can be noisy, though, and analysts often look at several quarters together before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Cependant, les chiffres trimestriels peuvent être volatils, et les analystes examinent souvent plusieurs trimestres ensemble avant de tirer des conclusions.

segments.src: ## The Main Drivers
segments.tr: ## Les principaux moteurs

segments.src: GDP is built from a few components: consumer spending, business investment, government spending, and net trade.
segments.tr: Le PIB est construit à partir de quelques composantes : les dépenses de consommation, l'investissement des entreprises, les dépenses publiques et le commerce net.

segments.src: Which of these moved most is usually the key to understanding a quarter.
segments.tr: Laquelle de ces composantes a le plus bougé est généralement la clé pour comprendre un trimestre.

segments.src: ### Consumers
segments.tr: ### Consommateurs

segments.src: Household spending is the largest piece of the economy, typically well over half of GDP.
segments.tr: Les dépenses des ménages constituent la plus grande partie de l'économie, généralement bien au-delà de la moitié du PIB.

segments.src: When consumers keep buying services such as travel, health care and dining out, as well as goods, growth tends to hold up.
segments.tr: Lorsque les consommateurs continuent d'acheter des services tels que les voyages, les soins de santé et les repas au restaurant, ainsi que des biens, la croissance a tendance à se maintenir.

segments.src: Strong spending does not always mean households are comfortable, however.
segments.tr: Cependant, une forte consommation ne signifie pas toujours que les ménages sont à l'aise.

segments.src: Some of it can reflect higher-income households spending freely.
segments.tr: Une partie de cela peut refléter des ménages à revenus plus élevés dépensant librement.

segments.src: Some can reflect people drawing down savings or leaning on credit to keep up with higher prices.
segments.tr: Une partie peut refléter des personnes puisant dans leurs épargnes ou s'appuyant sur le crédit pour faire face à la hausse des prix.

segments.src: ### AI-Related Investment
segments.tr: ### Investissement lié à l'IA

segments.src: Business investment has drawn particular attention because of heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
segments.tr: L'investissement des entreprises a attiré une attention particulière en raison des dépenses massives en infrastructure d'intelligence artificielle.

segments.src: Data centers, computing hardware, software and the power and construction work that support them all count as investment in GDP.
segments.tr: Les centres de données, le matériel informatique, les logiciels et les travaux d'électricité et de construction qui les soutiennent comptent tous comme de l'investissement dans le PIB.

segments.src: This spending can lift the headline figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Ces dépenses peuvent faire monter le chiffre principal de manière notable.

segments.src: It is also concentrated in a relatively small number of companies and industries.
segments.tr: Elles sont également concentrées dans un nombre relativement restreint d'entreprises et d'industries.

segments.src: A boom in server and data-center building can raise GDP without immediately changing the experience of a typical worker or renter.
segments.tr: Un boom de la construction de serveurs et de centres de données peut augmenter le PIB sans modifier immédiatement l'expérience d'un travailleur ou d'un locataire typique.

segments.src: ### Trade
segments.tr: ### Commerce

segments.src: Net exports are one of the more volatile pieces of the report.
segments.tr: Les exportations nettes sont l'une des composantes les plus volatiles du rapport.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP and exports add to it.
segments.tr: Les importations soustraient au PIB et les exportations y ajoutent.

segments.src: Swings in shipping, tariffs, inventory decisions and timing can move this component sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Les fluctuations des expéditions, des tarifs douaniers, des décisions d'inventaire et du calendrier peuvent faire bouger cette composante brusquement d'un trimestre à l'autre.

segments.src: A big shift in trade can make the headline number look stronger or weaker than the underlying demand.
segments.tr: Un changement important dans le commerce peut rendre le chiffre principal plus fort ou plus faible que la demande sous-jacente.

segments.src: For that reason, many economists also watch measures that strip out trade and inventories to get a cleaner read on domestic demand.
segments.tr: Pour cette raison, de nombreux économistes surveillent également les mesures qui excluent le commerce et les stocks pour obtenir une lecture plus claire de la demande intérieure.

segments.src: ### Government and Inventories
segments.tr: ### Gouvernement et stocks

segments.src: Government spending and changes in business inventories also contribute.
segments.tr: Les dépenses publiques et les variations des stocks des entreprises y contribuent également.

segments.src: Inventory swings in particular tend to reverse, so they can flatter one quarter and drag on the next.
segments.tr: Les fluctuations des stocks en particulier ont tendance à s'inverser, de sorte qu'elles peuvent avantager un trimestre et peser sur le suivant.

segments.src: ## Why It Can Still Feel Slower
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela peut toujours sembler plus lent

segments.src: If output is rising at a healthy clip, why do so many people feel stuck?
segments.tr: Si la production augmente à un rythme soutenu, pourquoi tant de gens se sentent-ils bloqués ?

segments.src: Several explanations are commonly offered by economists.
segments.tr: Plusieurs explications sont communément offertes par les économistes.

segments.src: Prices rise even when inflation cools.** Inflation measures how fast prices increase.
segments.tr: Les prix augmentent même lorsque l'inflation se calme.** L'inflation mesure la vitesse à laquelle les prix augmentent.

segments.src: A slowing rate does not mean prices fall.
segments.tr: Un taux en ralentissement ne signifie pas que les prix baissent.

segments.src: If the cost of food, housing or insurance jumped in earlier years, those higher levels remain.
segments.tr: Si le coût de la nourriture, du logement ou de l'assurance a bondi au cours des années précédentes, ces niveaux plus élevés demeurent.

segments.src: Households tend to judge the economy by the prices they see now, not by the pace of change.
segments.tr: Les ménages ont tendance à juger l'économie par les prix qu'ils voient maintenant, et non par le rythme du changement.

segments.src: Essentials weigh more than averages suggest.** Official inflation gauges average across many goods.
segments.tr: Les essentiels pèsent plus que ne le suggèrent les moyennes.** Les jauges officielles de l'inflation font la moyenne de nombreux biens.

segments.src: A household that spends a large share of its income on rent, groceries, childcare or health care may experience its own inflation rate as higher than the average.
segments.tr: Un ménage qui consacre une grande partie de son revenu au loyer, à l'épicerie, à la garde d'enfants ou aux soins de santé peut ressentir son propre taux d'inflation comme étant supérieur à la moyenne.

segments.src: Borrowing remains expensive.** Even if interest rates have eased from their peaks, mortgage, auto and credit-card costs can be well above where they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: L'emprunt reste cher.** Même si les taux d'intérêt ont baissé par rapport à leurs sommets, les coûts des prêts hypothécaires, automobiles et de cartes de crédit peuvent être bien supérieurs à ce qu'ils étaient il y a quelques années.

segments.src: That limits what many households can afford, whatever the national growth rate says.
segments.tr: Cela limite ce que de nombreux ménages peuvent se permettre, quel que soit le taux de croissance national.

segments.src: Growth is not evenly shared.** An economy can expand while gains flow mostly to business owners, investors and higher earners.
segments.tr: La croissance n'est pas répartie équitablement.** Une économie peut s'étendre tandis que les gains vont principalement aux propriétaires d'entreprises, aux investisseurs et aux hauts revenus.

segments.src: Wage growth that merely keeps pace with prices leaves little sense of progress.
segments.tr: Une croissance des salaires qui se contente de suivre les prix laisse peu de sentiment de progrès.

segments.src: Jobs and confidence are separate from output.** Growth can be strong while hiring slows or workers worry about job security.
segments.tr: Les emplois et la confiance sont distincts de la production.** La croissance peut être forte alors que l'embauche ralentit ou que les travailleurs s'inquiètent de la sécurité de l'emploi.

segments.src: Perceptions of the labor market often shape sentiment more than GDP does.
segments.tr: Les perceptions du marché du travail façonnent souvent le sentiment plus que ne le fait le PIB.

segments.src: GDP is not a measure of well-being.** It counts production, not savings, debt, housing affordability or financial stress.
segments.tr: Le PIB n'est pas une mesure du bien-être.** Il compte la production, et non l'épargne, la dette, l'accessibilité au logement ou le stress financier.

segments.src: A country can post strong GDP while many individuals feel squeezed.
segments.tr: Un pays peut afficher un PIB solide alors que de nombreux individus se sentent pressés.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: A single quarter does not settle the question.
segments.tr: Un seul trimestre ne règle pas la question.

segments.src: These indicators can help put the 3.4% figure in context:
segments.tr: Ces indicateurs peuvent aider à placer le chiffre de 3,4 % dans son contexte :

segments.src: - **Revisions to the GDP estimate**, which can change the story.
segments.tr: - **Les révisions de l'estimation du PIB**, qui peuvent changer l'histoire.

segments.src: - **Real disposable income**, meaning income after taxes and inflation, which says more about household capacity than GDP does.
segments.tr: - **Le revenu disponible réel**, c'est-à-dire le revenu après impôts et inflation, qui en dit plus sur la capacité des ménages que ne le fait le PIB.

segments.src: - **Wage growth compared with price growth**, since the gap between the two determines whether paychecks stretch further.
segments.tr: - **La croissance des salaires comparée à la croissance des prix**, puisque l'écart entre les deux détermine si les chèques de paie vont plus loin.

segments.src: - **Labor market data**, including hiring, unemployment and job openings.
segments.tr: - **Les données du marché du travail**, y compris l'embauche, le chômage et les offres d'emploi.

segments.src: - **Business investment outside the AI sector**, to see whether growth is broad or narrow.
segments.tr: - **L'investissement des entreprises en dehors du secteur de l'IA**, pour voir si la croissance est large ou étroite.

segments.src: - **Consumer sentiment surveys**, which capture how people feel, not only what they spend.
segments.tr: - **Les enquêtes sur le sentiment des consommateurs**, qui capturent ce que ressentent les gens, et non seulement ce qu'ils dépensent.

segments.src: ## A Practical Takeaway for Households
segments.tr: ## Un point à retenir pratique pour les ménages

segments.src: National statistics are useful for understanding the economy's direction.
segments.tr: Les statistiques nationales sont utiles pour comprendre la direction de l'économie.

segments.src: They are a poor guide to your own situation.
segments.tr: Elles sont un mauvais guide pour votre propre situation.

segments.src: A few general habits can help you separate the headlines from your own finances:
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes générales peuvent vous aider à séparer les gros titres de vos propres finances :

segments.src: - Track your own budget, especially the categories that have risen fastest.
segments.tr: - Suivez votre propre budget, en particulier les catégories qui ont augmenté le plus rapidement.

segments.src: - Compare your income growth with the prices you actually pay.
segments.tr: - Comparez la croissance de vos revenus avec les prix que vous payez réellement.

segments.src: - Review variable-rate debt and think about what a change in rates would mean for you.
segments.tr: - Examinez la dette à taux variable et réfléchissez à ce qu'un changement de taux signifierait pour vous.

segments.src: - Keep an emergency cushion if you can, since a strong economy does not guarantee job stability.
segments.tr: - Gardez un coussin d'urgence si vous le pouvez, car une économie forte ne garantit pas la stabilité de l'emploi.

segments.src: - Treat any single data release as one data point, not a forecast.
segments.tr: - Traitez toute publication de données unique comme un point de données, et non comme une prévision.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A 3.4% annualized growth rate points to an economy with real momentum, helped by consumer spending, heavy AI-related investment and shifts in trade.
segments.tr: Un taux de croissance annualisé de 3,4 % indique une économie dotée d'une réelle dynamique, aidée par les dépenses de consommation, les investissements massifs liés à l'IA et les changements dans le commerce.

segments.src: But GDP measures total output.
segments.tr: Mais le PIB mesure la production totale.

segments.src: It does not measure how comfortable families feel after paying for housing, food and debt.
segments.tr: Il ne mesure pas à quel point les familles se sentent à l'aise après avoir payé le logement, la nourriture et la dette.

segments.src: The gap between a strong headline and a tight household budget is not a contradiction.
segments.tr: L'écart entre un titre fort et un budget de ménage serré n'est pas une contradiction.

segments.src: It reflects the difference between how much an economy produces and how that production, and the price of living, show up in daily life.
segments.tr: Il reflète la différence entre la quantité qu'une économie produit et la façon dont cette production, et le prix de la vie, apparaissent dans la vie quotidienne.

segments.src: *Figures cited reflect the initial third-quarter estimate and may be revised.
segments.tr: *Les chiffres cités reflètent l'estimation initiale du troisième trimestre et peuvent être révisés.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources, such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis, for the latest data.*
segments.tr: Les lecteurs doivent consulter les sources officielles, telles que le Bureau of Economic Analysis, pour obtenir les dernières données.*

pt.title: Crescimento de 3,4%, então por que parece mais lento? Lendo o relatório do PIB do terceiro trimestre

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: A economia dos

segments.src: economy grew at a 3.4% annualized rate in the third quarter, up from 2.2% in the second.
segments.tr: EUA cresceu a uma taxa anualizada de 3,4% no terceiro trimestre, acima dos 2,2% no segundo.

segments.src: By the usual yardsticks, that is a solid number.
segments.tr: Pelos critérios usuais, esse é um número sólido.

segments.src: Yet plenty of households say they feel no stronger, because grocery bills, rent, insurance and borrowing costs still weigh on their budgets.
segments.tr: No entanto, muitas famílias dizem que não se sentem mais fortes, porque as contas de supermercado, aluguel, seguros e custos de empréstimos ainda pesam em seus orçamentos.

segments.src: Both things can be true.
segments.tr: Ambas as coisas podem ser verdadeiras.

segments.src: GDP and a family's finances measure different things.
segments.tr: O PIB e as finanças de uma família medem coisas diferentes.

segments.src: This article looks at what the headline figure captures, what tends to drive it, and why it can diverge from everyday experience.
segments.tr: Este artigo analisa o que o número principal captura, o que tende a impulsioná-lo e por que ele pode divergir da experiência cotidiana.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: Não constitui aconselhamento de investimento, fiscal ou financeiro.*

segments.src: ## What the 3.4% Actually Means
segments.tr: ## O que os 3,4% realmente significam

segments.src: Gross domestic product is the total value of goods and services produced in the country over a period.
segments.tr: O produto interno bruto é o valor total de bens e serviços produzidos no país durante um período.

segments.src: Government statisticians report the quarterly change as an **annualized** rate.
segments.tr: Os estatísticos do governo relatam a variação trimestral como uma taxa **anualizada**.

segments.src: That is the pace the economy would reach if the quarter's growth continued for a full year.
segments.tr: Esse é o ritmo que a economia atingiria se o crescimento do trimestre continuasse por um ano inteiro.

segments.src: A 3.4% reading does not mean the economy grew 3.4% in three months.
segments.tr: Uma leitura de 3,4% não significa que a economia cresceu 3,4% em três meses.

segments.src: It means it expanded at a pace that, sustained, would add up to 3.4% over twelve months.
segments.tr: Significa que ela se expandiu a um ritmo que, se sustentado, somaria 3,4% ao longo de doze meses.

segments.src: Three features of the figure matter for interpretation:
segments.tr: Três características do número são importantes para a interpretação:

segments.src: - **It is an early estimate.** The first reading is based on incomplete data and is usually revised as more information arrives. Revisions can be meaningful.
segments.tr: - **É uma estimativa inicial.** A primeira leitura baseia-se em dados incompletos e geralmente é revisada à medida que mais informações chegam. As revisões podem ser significativas.

segments.src: - **It is adjusted for inflation.** The headline is "real" GDP. It strips out price changes to show changes in output.
segments.tr: - **É ajustado pela inflação.** O número principal é o PIB "real". Ele exclui as variações de preços para mostrar as mudanças na produção.

segments.src: - **It is an aggregate.** It tells you how big the total pie grew. It does not tell you who got the larger slices.
segments.tr: - **É um agregado.** Ele informa o quanto o bolo total cresceu. Não informa quem ficou com as fatias maiores.

segments.src: The acceleration from 2.2% to 3.4% suggests momentum improved.
segments.tr: A aceleração de 2,2% para 3,4% sugere que o ímpeto melhorou.

segments.src: Quarterly figures can be noisy, though, and analysts often look at several quarters together before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Os números trimestrais podem ser ruidosos, no entanto, e os analistas frequentemente observam vários trimestres juntos antes de tirar conclusões.

segments.src: ## The Main Drivers
segments.tr: ## Os principais impulsionadores

segments.src: GDP is built from a few components: consumer spending, business investment, government spending, and net trade.
segments.tr: O PIB é construído a partir de alguns componentes: gastos do consumidor, investimento empresarial, gastos do governo e comércio líquido.

segments.src: Which of these moved most is usually the key to understanding a quarter.
segments.tr: Qual deles se moveu mais é geralmente a chave para entender um trimestre.

segments.src: ### Consumers
segments.tr: ### Consumidores

segments.src: Household spending is the largest piece of the economy, typically well over half of GDP.
segments.tr: Os gastos das famílias são a maior parte da economia, normalmente bem mais da metade do PIB.

segments.src: When consumers keep buying services such as travel, health care and dining out, as well as goods, growth tends to hold up.
segments.tr: Quando os consumidores continuam comprando serviços como viagens, saúde e refeições fora de casa, bem como bens, o crescimento tende a se manter.

segments.src: Strong spending does not always mean households are comfortable, however.
segments.tr: Gastos fortes nem sempre significam que as famílias estão confortáveis, no entanto.

segments.src: Some of it can reflect higher-income households spending freely.
segments.tr: Parte disso pode refletir famílias de renda mais alta gastando livremente.

segments.src: Some can reflect people drawing down savings or leaning on credit to keep up with higher prices.
segments.tr: Parte pode refletir pessoas usando suas economias ou recorrendo ao crédito para acompanhar os preços mais altos.

segments.src: ### AI-Related Investment
segments.tr: ### Investimento relacionado à IA

segments.src: Business investment has drawn particular attention because of heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
segments.tr: O investimento empresarial tem chamado atenção especial devido aos pesados gastos em infraestrutura de inteligência artificial.

segments.src: Data centers, computing hardware, software and the power and construction work that support them all count as investment in GDP.
segments.tr: Centros de dados, hardware de computação, software e o trabalho de energia e construção que os apoiam contam como investimento no PIB.

segments.src: This spending can lift the headline figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Esses gastos podem elevar o número principal de forma notável.

segments.src: It is also concentrated in a relatively small number of companies and industries.
segments.tr: Eles também estão concentrados em um número relativamente pequeno de empresas e setores.

segments.src: A boom in server and data-center building can raise GDP without immediately changing the experience of a typical worker or renter.
segments.tr: Um boom na construção de servidores e centros de dados pode aumentar o PIB sem mudar imediatamente a experiência de um trabalhador ou inquilino típico.

segments.src: ### Trade
segments.tr: ### Comércio

segments.src: Net exports are one of the more volatile pieces of the report.
segments.tr: As exportações líquidas são uma das partes mais voláteis do relatório.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP and exports add to it.
segments.tr: As importações subtraem do PIB e as exportações adicionam a ele.

segments.src: Swings in shipping, tariffs, inventory decisions and timing can move this component sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Oscilações no transporte, tarifas, decisões de estoque e cronograma podem mover esse componente bruscamente de um trimestre para o outro.

segments.src: A big shift in trade can make the headline number look stronger or weaker than the underlying demand.
segments.tr: Uma grande mudança no comércio pode fazer com que o número principal pareça mais forte ou mais fraco do que a demanda subjacente.

segments.src: For that reason, many economists also watch measures that strip out trade and inventories to get a cleaner read on domestic demand.
segments.tr: Por esse motivo, muitos economistas também observam medidas que excluem o comércio e os estoques para obter uma leitura mais clara da demanda doméstica.

segments.src: ### Government and Inventories
segments.tr: ### Governo e estoques

segments.src: Government spending and changes in business inventories also contribute.
segments.tr: Os gastos do governo e as mudanças nos estoques das empresas também contribuem.

segments.src: Inventory swings in particular tend to reverse, so they can flatter one quarter and drag on the next.
segments.tr: As oscilações de estoque, em particular, tendem a se reverter, então podem favorecer um trimestre e prejudicar o próximo.

segments.src: ## Why It Can Still Feel Slower
segments.tr: ## Por que ainda pode parecer mais lento

segments.src: If output is rising at a healthy clip, why do so many people feel stuck?
segments.tr: Se a produção está aumentando em um ritmo saudável, por que tantas pessoas se sentem estagnadas?

segments.src: Several explanations are commonly offered by economists.
segments.tr: Várias explicações são comumente oferecidas pelos economistas.

segments.src: Prices rise even when inflation cools.** Inflation measures how fast prices increase.
segments.tr: Os preços sobem mesmo quando a inflação esfria.** A inflação mede a rapidez com que os preços aumentam.

segments.src: A slowing rate does not mean prices fall.
segments.tr: Uma taxa de desaceleração não significa que os preços caiam.

segments.src: If the cost of food, housing or insurance jumped in earlier years, those higher levels remain.
segments.tr: Se o custo de alimentos, moradia ou seguros disparou em anos anteriores, esses níveis mais altos permanecem.

segments.src: Households tend to judge the economy by the prices they see now, not by the pace of change.
segments.tr: As famílias tendem a julgar a economia pelos preços que veem agora, não pelo ritmo de mudança.

segments.src: Essentials weigh more than averages suggest.** Official inflation gauges average across many goods.
segments.tr: Os itens essenciais pesam mais do que as médias sugerem.** Os indicadores oficiais de inflação fazem a média de muitos bens.

segments.src: A household that spends a large share of its income on rent, groceries, childcare or health care may experience its own inflation rate as higher than the average.
segments.tr: Uma família que gasta uma grande parte de sua renda com aluguel, supermercado, creche ou saúde pode experimentar sua própria taxa de inflação como sendo mais alta do que a média.

segments.src: Borrowing remains expensive.** Even if interest rates have eased from their peaks, mortgage, auto and credit-card costs can be well above where they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: O crédito continua caro.** Mesmo que as taxas de juros tenham diminuído em relação aos seus picos, os custos de hipotecas, automóveis e cartões de crédito podem estar bem acima de onde estavam há alguns anos.

segments.src: That limits what many households can afford, whatever the national growth rate says.
segments.tr: Isso limita o que muitas famílias podem pagar, independentemente do que a taxa de crescimento nacional diga.

segments.src: Growth is not evenly shared.** An economy can expand while gains flow mostly to business owners, investors and higher earners.
segments.tr: O crescimento não é compartilhado uniformemente.** Uma economia pode se expandir enquanto os ganhos fluem principalmente para proprietários de empresas, investidores e pessoas de renda mais alta.

segments.src: Wage growth that merely keeps pace with prices leaves little sense of progress.
segments.tr: O crescimento salarial que apenas acompanha os preços deixa pouca sensação de progresso.

segments.src: Jobs and confidence are separate from output.** Growth can be strong while hiring slows or workers worry about job security.
segments.tr: Empregos e confiança são separados da produção.** O crescimento pode ser forte enquanto a contratação diminui ou os trabalhadores se preocupam com a segurança no emprego.

segments.src: Perceptions of the labor market often shape sentiment more than GDP does.
segments.tr: As percepções do mercado de trabalho muitas vezes moldam o sentimento mais do que o PIB.

segments.src: GDP is not a measure of well-being.** It counts production, not savings, debt, housing affordability or financial stress.
segments.tr: O PIB não é uma medida de bem-estar.** Ele conta a produção, não as economias, dívidas, acessibilidade à moradia ou estresse financeiro.

segments.src: A country can post strong GDP while many individuals feel squeezed.
segments.tr: Um país pode registrar um PIB forte enquanto muitos indivíduos se sentem pressionados.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: A single quarter does not settle the question.
segments.tr: Um único trimestre não resolve a questão.

segments.src: These indicators can help put the 3.4% figure in context:
segments.tr: Esses indicadores podem ajudar a colocar o número de 3,4% em contexto:

segments.src: - **Revisions to the GDP estimate**, which can change the story.
segments.tr: - **Revisões na estimativa do PIB**, que podem mudar a história.

segments.src: - **Real disposable income**, meaning income after taxes and inflation, which says more about household capacity than GDP does.
segments.tr: - **Renda real disponível**, ou seja, renda após impostos e inflação, que diz mais sobre a capacidade das famílias do que o PIB.

segments.src: - **Wage growth compared with price growth**, since the gap between the two determines whether paychecks stretch further.
segments.tr: - **Crescimento salarial em comparação com o crescimento dos preços**, já que a diferença entre os dois determina se os salários rendem mais.

segments.src: - **Labor market data**, including hiring, unemployment and job openings.
segments.tr: - **Dados do mercado de trabalho**, incluindo contratações, desemprego e vagas de emprego.

segments.src: - **Business investment outside the AI sector**, to see whether growth is broad or narrow.
segments.tr: - **Investimento empresarial fora do setor de IA**, para ver se o crescimento é amplo ou restrito.

segments.src: - **Consumer sentiment surveys**, which capture how people feel, not only what they spend.
segments.tr: - **Pesquisas de sentimento do consumidor**, que capturam como as pessoas se sentem, não apenas o que gastam.

segments.src: ## A Practical Takeaway for Households
segments.tr: ## Uma conclusão prática para as famílias

segments.src: National statistics are useful for understanding the economy's direction.
segments.tr: As estatísticas nacionais são úteis para entender a direção da economia.

segments.src: They are a poor guide to your own situation.
segments.tr: Elas são um guia ruim para sua própria situação.

segments.src: A few general habits can help you separate the headlines from your own finances:
segments.tr: Alguns hábitos gerais podem ajudá-lo a separar as manchetes de suas próprias finanças:

segments.src: - Track your own budget, especially the categories that have risen fastest.
segments.tr: - Acompanhe seu próprio orçamento, especialmente as categorias que aumentaram mais rapidamente.

segments.src: - Compare your income growth with the prices you actually pay.
segments.tr: - Compare o crescimento da sua renda com os preços que você realmente paga.

segments.src: - Review variable-rate debt and think about what a change in rates would mean for you.
segments.tr: - Revise dívidas com taxas variáveis e pense sobre o que uma mudança nas taxas significaria para você.

segments.src: - Keep an emergency cushion if you can, since a strong economy does not guarantee job stability.
segments.tr: - Mantenha uma reserva de emergência, se puder, já que uma economia forte não garante estabilidade no emprego.

segments.src: - Treat any single data release as one data point, not a forecast.
segments.tr: - Trate qualquer divulgação de dados única como um ponto de dados, não como uma previsão.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Resumo

segments.src: A 3.4% annualized growth rate points to an economy with real momentum, helped by consumer spending, heavy AI-related investment and shifts in trade.
segments.tr: Uma taxa de crescimento anualizada de 3,4% aponta para uma economia com ímpeto real, ajudada pelos gastos do consumidor, pesados investimentos relacionados à IA e mudanças no comércio.

segments.src: But GDP measures total output.
segments.tr: Mas o PIB mede a produção total.

segments.tr: ## Apa Arti Sebenarnya dari 3,4%

segments.src: Gross domestic product is the total value of goods and services produced in the country over a period.
segments.tr: Produk domestik bruto adalah total nilai barang dan jasa yang diproduksi di dalam negeri selama suatu periode.

segments.src: Government statisticians report the quarterly change as an **annualized** rate.
segments.tr: Para ahli statistik pemerintah melaporkan perubahan kuartal sebagai tingkat **disetahunkan** (annualized).

segments.src: That is the pace the economy would reach if the quarter's growth continued for a full year.
segments.tr: Itu adalah laju yang akan dicapai ekonomi jika pertumbuhan kuartal tersebut berlanjut selama setahun penuh.

segments.src: A 3.4% reading does not mean the economy grew 3.4% in three months.
segments.tr: Pembacaan 3,4% tidak berarti ekonomi tumbuh 3,4% dalam tiga bulan.

segments.src: It means it expanded at a pace that, sustained, would add up to 3.4% over twelve months.
segments.tr: Artinya, ekonomi berekspansi pada laju yang, jika dipertahankan, akan berjumlah 3,4% selama dua belas bulan.

segments.src: Three features of the figure matter for interpretation:
segments.tr: Tiga ciri dari angka tersebut penting untuk interpretasi:

segments.src: - **It is an early estimate.** The first reading is based on incomplete data and is usually revised as more information arrives. Revisions can be meaningful.
segments.tr: - **Ini adalah perkiraan awal.** Pembacaan pertama didasarkan pada data yang tidak lengkap dan biasanya direvisi saat lebih banyak informasi tiba. Revisi bisa bermakna.

segments.src: - **It is adjusted for inflation.** The headline is "real" GDP. It strips out price changes to show changes in output.
segments.tr: - **Ini disesuaikan dengan inflasi.** Angka utama adalah PDB "riil". Angka ini menghilangkan perubahan harga untuk menunjukkan perubahan output.

segments.src: - **It is an aggregate.** It tells you how big the total pie grew. It does not tell you who got the larger slices.
segments.tr: - **Ini adalah agregat.** Angka ini memberi tahu Anda seberapa besar total kue tumbuh. Angka ini tidak memberi tahu Anda siapa yang mendapat bagian lebih besar.

segments.src: The acceleration from 2.2% to 3.4% suggests momentum improved.
segments.tr: Akselerasi dari 2,2% ke 3,4% menyiratkan momentum meningkat.

segments.src: Quarterly figures can be noisy, though, and analysts often look at several quarters together before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Namun, angka kuartalan bisa fluktuatif, dan para analis sering melihat beberapa kuartal secara bersamaan sebelum menarik kesimpulan.

segments.src: ## The Main Drivers
segments.tr: ## Penggerak Utama

segments.src: GDP is built from a few components: consumer spending, business investment, government spending, and net trade.
segments.tr: PDB dibangun dari beberapa komponen: pengeluaran konsumen, investasi bisnis, pengeluaran pemerintah, dan perdagangan bersih.

segments.src: Which of these moved most is usually the key to understanding a quarter.
segments.tr: Mana dari komponen ini yang paling bergerak biasanya menjadi kunci untuk memahami suatu kuartal.

segments.src: ### Consumers
segments.tr: ### Konsumen

segments.src: Household spending is the largest piece of the economy, typically well over half of GDP.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran rumah tangga adalah bagian terbesar dari ekonomi, biasanya jauh melebihi separuh PDB.

segments.src: When consumers keep buying services such as travel, health care and dining out, as well as goods, growth tends to hold up.
segments.tr: Ketika konsumen terus membeli jasa seperti perjalanan, perawatan kesehatan, dan makan di luar, serta barang, pertumbuhan cenderung bertahan.

segments.src: Strong spending does not always mean households are comfortable, however.
segments.tr: Namun, pengeluaran yang kuat tidak selalu berarti rumah tangga merasa nyaman.

segments.src: Some of it can reflect higher-income households spending freely.
segments.tr: Sebagian dari hal itu dapat mencerminkan rumah tangga berpendapatan lebih tinggi yang membelanjakan uang secara bebas.

segments.src: Some can reflect people drawing down savings or leaning on credit to keep up with higher prices.
segments.tr: Sebagian dapat mencerminkan orang-orang yang menarik tabungan atau mengandalkan kredit untuk mengimbangi harga yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ### AI-Related Investment
segments.tr: ### Investasi Terkait AI

segments.src: Business investment has drawn particular attention because of heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
segments.tr: Investasi bisnis telah menarik perhatian khusus karena pengeluaran besar pada infrastruktur kecerdasan buatan.

segments.src: Data centers, computing hardware, software and the power and construction work that support them all count as investment in GDP.
segments.tr: Pusat data, perangkat keras komputer, perangkat lunak, serta pekerjaan tenaga dan konstruksi yang mendukungnya semuanya dihitung sebagai investasi dalam PDB.

segments.src: This spending can lift the headline figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran ini dapat menaikkan angka utama secara nyata.

segments.src: It is also concentrated in a relatively small number of companies and industries.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran ini juga terkonsentrasi di sejumlah kecil perusahaan dan industri.

segments.src: A boom in server and data-center building can raise GDP without immediately changing the experience of a typical worker or renter.
segments.tr: Ledakan pembangunan server dan pusat data dapat menaikkan PDB tanpa langsung mengubah pengalaman pekerja atau penyewa biasa.

segments.src: ### Trade
segments.tr: ### Perdagangan

segments.src: Net exports are one of the more volatile pieces of the report.
segments.tr: Ekspor neto adalah salah satu bagian laporan yang lebih volatil.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP and exports add to it.
segments.tr: Impor mengurangi PDB dan ekspor menambahnya.

segments.src: Swings in shipping, tariffs, inventory decisions and timing can move this component sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Lonjakan dalam pengiriman, tarif, keputusan persediaan, dan waktu dapat menggerakkan komponen ini secara tajam dari satu kuartal ke kuartal berikutnya.

segments.src: A big shift in trade can make the headline number look stronger or weaker than the underlying demand.
segments.tr: Pergeseran besar dalam perdagangan dapat membuat angka utama terlihat lebih kuat atau lebih lemah daripada permintaan yang mendasarinya.

segments.src: For that reason, many economists also watch measures that strip out trade and inventories to get a cleaner read on domestic demand.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, banyak ekonom juga mengamati ukuran yang menghilangkan perdagangan dan persediaan untuk mendapatkan bacaan yang lebih bersih tentang permintaan domestik.

segments.src: ### Government and Inventories
segments.tr: ### Pemerintah dan Persediaan

segments.src: Government spending and changes in business inventories also contribute.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran pemerintah dan perubahan persediaan bisnis juga turut berkontribusi.

segments.src: Inventory swings in particular tend to reverse, so they can flatter one quarter and drag on the next.
segments.tr: Lonjakan persediaan khususnya cenderung berbalik, sehingga dapat mempercantik satu kuartal dan menyeret kuartal berikutnya.

segments.src: ## Why It Can Still Feel Slower
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Masih Terasa Lebih Lambat

segments.src: If output is rising at a healthy clip, why do so many people feel stuck?
segments.tr: Jika output naik dengan laju yang sehat, mengapa begitu banyak orang merasa terjebak?

segments.src: Several explanations are commonly offered by economists.
segments.tr: Beberapa penjelasan umumnya ditawarkan oleh para ekonom.

segments.src: Prices rise even when inflation cools.** Inflation measures how fast prices increase.
segments.tr: Harga naik bahkan ketika inflasi mendingin.** Inflasi mengukur seberapa cepat harga meningkat.

segments.src: A slowing rate does not mean prices fall.
segments.tr: Laju yang melambat bukan berarti harga turun.

segments.src: If the cost of food, housing or insurance jumped in earlier years, those higher levels remain.
segments.tr: Jika biaya makanan, perumahan, atau asuransi melonjak pada tahun-tahun sebelumnya, tingkat yang lebih tinggi tersebut tetap ada.

segments.src: Households tend to judge the economy by the prices they see now, not by the pace of change.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga cenderung menilai ekonomi berdasarkan harga yang mereka lihat sekarang, bukan berdasarkan laju perubahan.

segments.src: Essentials weigh more than averages suggest.** Official inflation gauges average across many goods.
segments.tr: Kebutuhan pokok membebani lebih dari yang disarankan rata-rata.** Tolok ukur inflasi resmi merata di banyak barang.

segments.src: A household that spends a large share of its income on rent, groceries, childcare or health care may experience its own inflation rate as higher than the average.
segments.tr: Sebuah rumah tangga yang menghabiskan sebagian besar pendapatannya untuk sewa, bahan makanan, penitipan anak, atau perawatan kesehatan dapat mengalami tingkat inflasinya sendiri yang lebih tinggi daripada rata-rata.

segments.src: Borrowing remains expensive.** Even if interest rates have eased from their peaks, mortgage, auto and credit-card costs can be well above where they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: Peminjaman tetap mahal.** Bahkan jika suku bunga telah mereda dari puncaknya, biaya hipotek, mobil, dan kartu kredit bisa jauh di atas posisi beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.src: That limits what many households can afford, whatever the national growth rate says.
segments.tr: Hal itu membatasi apa yang mampu dibeli oleh banyak rumah tangga, apa pun kata tingkat pertumbuhan nasional.

segments.src: Growth is not evenly shared.** An economy can expand while gains flow mostly to business owners, investors and higher earners.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan tidak dibagikan secara merata.** Sebuah ekonomi dapat berekspansi sementara keuntungan mengalir sebagian besar kepada pemilik bisnis, investor, dan mereka yang berpenghasilan lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Wage growth that merely keeps pace with prices leaves little sense of progress.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan upah yang hanya mengimbangi harga menyisakan sedikit rasa kemajuan.

segments.src: Jobs and confidence are separate from output.** Growth can be strong while hiring slows or workers worry about job security.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan dan keyakinan terpisah dari output.** Pertumbuhan bisa kuat sementara perekrutan melambat atau pekerja khawatir tentang keamanan kerja.

segments.src: Perceptions of the labor market often shape sentiment more than GDP does.
segments.tr: Persepsi pasar tenaga kerja sering kali membentuk sentimen lebih daripada yang dilakukan PDB.

segments.src: GDP is not a measure of well-being.** It counts production, not savings, debt, housing affordability or financial stress.
segments.tr: PDB bukanlah ukuran kesejahteraan.** PDB menghitung produksi, bukan tabungan, utang, keterjangkauan perumahan, atau tekanan keuangan.

segments.src: A country can post strong GDP while many individuals feel squeezed.
segments.tr: Sebuah negara dapat membukukan PDB yang kuat sementara banyak individu merasa tertekan.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: A single quarter does not settle the question.
segments.tr: Satu kuartal tidak menyelesaikan masalah.

segments.src: These indicators can help put the 3.4% figure in context:
segments.tr: Indikator-indikator ini dapat membantu menempatkan angka 3,4% dalam konteks:

segments.src: - **Revisions to the GDP estimate**, which can change the story.
segments.tr: - **Revisi terhadap perkiraan PDB**, yang dapat mengubah cerita.

segments.src: - **Real disposable income**, meaning income after taxes and inflation, which says more about household capacity than GDP does.
segments.tr: - **Pendapatan disposable riil**, yang berarti pendapatan setelah pajak dan inflasi, yang mengatakan lebih banyak tentang kapasitas rumah tangga daripada PDB.

segments.src: - **Wage growth compared with price growth**, since the gap between the two determines whether paychecks stretch further.
segments.tr: - **Pertumbuhan upah dibandingkan dengan pertumbuhan harga**, karena kesenjangan antara keduanya menentukan apakah gaji dapat menjangkau lebih jauh.

segments.src: - **Labor market data**, including hiring, unemployment and job openings.
segments.tr: - **Data pasar tenaga kerja**, termasuk perekrutan, pengangguran, dan lowongan pekerjaan.

segments.src: - **Business investment outside the AI sector**, to see whether growth is broad or narrow.
segments.tr: - **Investasi bisnis di luar sektor AI**, untuk melihat apakah pertumbuhan itu luas atau sempit.

segments.src: - **Consumer sentiment surveys**, which capture how people feel, not only what they spend.
segments.tr: - **Survei sentimen konsumen**, yang menangkap bagaimana perasaan orang, bukan hanya apa yang mereka belanjakan.

segments.src: ## A Practical Takeaway for Households
segments.tr: ## Pelajaran Praktis bagi Rumah Tangga

segments.src: National statistics are useful for understanding the economy's direction.
segments.tr: Statistik nasional berguna untuk memahami arah ekonomi.

segments.src: They are a poor guide to your own situation.
segments.tr: Statistik tersebut adalah panduan yang buruk untuk situasi Anda sendiri.

segments.src: A few general habits can help you separate the headlines from your own finances:
segments.tr: Beberapa kebiasaan umum dapat membantu Anda memisahkan berita utama dari keuangan Anda sendiri:

segments.src: - Track your own budget, especially the categories that have risen fastest.
segments.tr: - Lacak anggaran Anda sendiri, terutama kategori yang paling cepat naik.

segments.src: - Compare your income growth with the prices you actually pay.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan pertumbuhan pendapatan Anda dengan harga yang sebenarnya Anda bayar.

segments.src: - Review variable-rate debt and think about what a change in rates would mean for you.
segments.tr: - Tinjau utang tingkat variabel dan pikirkan apa artinya perubahan suku bunga bagi Anda.

segments.src: - Keep an emergency cushion if you can, since a strong economy does not guarantee job stability.
segments.tr: - Simpan cadangan darurat jika Anda bisa, karena ekonomi yang kuat tidak menjamin stabilitas kerja.

segments.src: - Treat any single data release as one data point, not a forecast.
segments.tr: - Perlakukan rilis data tunggal apa pun sebagai satu titik data, bukan prakiraan.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A 3.4% annualized growth rate points to an economy with real momentum, helped by consumer spending, heavy AI-related investment and shifts in trade.
segments.tr: Tingkat pertumbuhan disetahunkan sebesar 3,4% menunjuk pada ekonomi dengan momentum nyata, dibantu oleh pengeluaran konsumen, investasi terkait AI yang berat, dan pergeseran perdagangan.

segments.src: But GDP measures total output.
segments.tr: Namun PDB mengukur total output.

segments.src: It does not measure how comfortable families feel after paying for housing, food and debt.
segments.tr: PDB tidak mengukur seberapa nyaman perasaan keluarga setelah membayar perumahan, makanan, dan utang.

segments.src: The gap between a strong headline and a tight household budget is not a contradiction.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan antara tajuk berita yang kuat dan anggaran rumah tangga yang ketat bukanlah sebuah kontradiksi.

segments.src: It reflects the difference between how much an economy produces and how that production, and the price of living, show up in daily life.
segments.tr: Hal itu mencerminkan perbedaan antara seberapa banyak ekonomi menghasilkan dan bagaimana produksi tersebut, serta harga kehidupan, muncul dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

segments.src: *Figures cited reflect the initial third-quarter estimate and may be revised.
segments.tr: *Angka yang dikutip mencerminkan perkiraan awal kuartal ketiga dan dapat direvisi.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources, such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis, for the latest data.*
segments.tr: Pembaca harus berkonsultasi dengan sumber resmi, seperti Biro Analisis Ekonomi, untuk data terbaru.*

ja.title: 3.4%の成長、なぜ低迷を感じるのか？第3四半期GDPレポートの読み方

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米国

segments.src: economy grew at a 3.4% annualized rate in the third quarter, up from 2.2% in the second.
segments.tr: 経済は第3四半期に年率3.4%で成長し、第2四半期の2.2%から上昇しました。

segments.src: By the usual yardsticks, that is a solid number.
segments.tr: 通常の尺度で見れば、これは堅実な数字です。

segments.src: Yet plenty of households say they feel no stronger, because grocery bills, rent, insurance and borrowing costs still weigh on their budgets.
segments.tr: しかし、食料品代、家賃、保険料、借入コストが依然として家計を圧迫しているため、生活が楽になったとは感じられないという世帯が多く存在します。

segments.src: Both things can be true.
segments.tr: そのどちらも真実であり得ます。

segments.src: GDP and a family's finances measure different things.
segments.tr: GDPと家計の財務状況は、異なるものを測定しているからです。

segments.src: This article looks at what the headline figure captures, what tends to drive it, and why it can diverge from everyday experience.
segments.tr: この記事では、ヘッドライン（主要）指標が何を捉え、何がそれを牽引する傾向があり、なぜそれが日常の感覚と乖離する可能性があるのかを考察します。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としています。

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: 投資、税務、または財務に関するアドバイスではありません。*

segments.src: ## What the 3.4% Actually Means
segments.tr: ## 3.4%が実際に意味すること

segments.src: Gross domestic product is the total value of goods and services produced in the country over a period.
segments.tr: 国内総生産（GDP）は、一定期間内に国内で生産された財とサービスの総価値です。

segments.src: Government statisticians report the quarterly change as an **annualized** rate.
segments.tr: 政府の統計担当者は、四半期ごとの変化を**年率**で報告します。

segments.src: That is the pace the economy would reach if the quarter's growth continued for a full year.
segments.tr: これは、その四半期の成長が1年間続いた場合に経済が到達するペースのことです。

segments.src: A 3.4% reading does not mean the economy grew 3.4% in three months.
segments.tr: 3.4%という数値は、経済が3か月間で3.4%成長したことを意味するわけではありません。

segments.src: It means it expanded at a pace that, sustained, would add up to 3.4% over twelve months.
segments.tr: それは、そのペースが維持された場合、12か月間で3.4%になるという拡大ペースを意味します。

segments.src: Three features of the figure matter for interpretation:
segments.tr: この数値を解釈する上で、3つの特徴が重要です。

segments.src: - **It is an early estimate.** The first reading is based on incomplete data and is usually revised as more information arrives. Revisions can be meaningful.
segments.tr: - **初期推計であること。** 最初の数値は不完全なデータに基づいており、より多くの情報が入るにつれて通常は修正されます。修正は重要な意味を持つことがあります。

segments.src: - **It is adjusted for inflation.** The headline is "real" GDP. It strips out price changes to show changes in output.
segments.tr: - **インフレ調整済みであること。** ヘッドライン数値は「実質」GDPです。価格変動を取り除き、生産量の変化を示します。

segments.src: - **It is an aggregate.** It tells you how big the total pie grew. It does not tell you who got the larger slices.
segments.tr: - **集計値であること。** 経済というパイ全体がどれだけ大きくなったかを示すものであり、誰がより大きな分け前を得たかを示すものではありません。

segments.src: The acceleration from 2.2% to 3.4% suggests momentum improved.
segments.tr: 2.2%から3.4%への加速は、勢いが増したことを示唆しています。

segments.src: Quarterly figures can be noisy, though, and analysts often look at several quarters together before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: ただし、四半期ごとの数値は変動が激しい場合があり、アナリストは結論を出す前に複数の四半期をまとめて見ることがよくあります。

segments.src: ## The Main Drivers
segments.tr: ## 主な牽引要因

segments.src: GDP is built from a few components: consumer spending, business investment, government spending, and net trade.
segments.tr: GDPは、個人消費、企業投資、政府支出、純貿易といういくつかの構成要素から成り立っています。

segments.src: Which of these moved most is usually the key to understanding a quarter.
segments.tr: これらのうちどれが最も動いたかが、四半期を理解する鍵となるのが通常です。

segments.src: ### Consumers
segments.tr: ### 消費者

segments.src: Household spending is the largest piece of the economy, typically well over half of GDP.
segments.tr: 家計支出は経済の最大の構成要素であり、通常GDPの半分を大きく上回ります。

segments.src: When consumers keep buying services such as travel, health care and dining out, as well as goods, growth tends to hold up.
segments.tr: 消費者が旅行、医療、外食などのサービスや物品を買い続ける限り、成長は維持される傾向があります。

segments.src: Strong spending does not always mean households are comfortable, however.
segments.tr: しかし、支出が堅調だからといって、必ずしも家計が楽であるとは限りません。

segments.src: Some of it can reflect higher-income households spending freely.
segments.tr: その一部は、高所得世帯が自由に支出していることを反映している可能性があります。

segments.src: Some can reflect people drawing down savings or leaning on credit to keep up with higher prices.
segments.tr: また、物価上昇に対応するために貯蓄を取り崩したり、クレジットに頼ったりしている人々を反映している場合もあります。

segments.src: ### AI-Related Investment
segments.tr: ### AI関連投資

segments.src: Business investment has drawn particular attention because of heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
segments.tr: 企業投資は、人工知能（AI）インフラへの巨額の支出により特に注目を集めています。

segments.src: Data centers, computing hardware, software and the power and construction work that support them all count as investment in GDP.
segments.tr: データセンター、コンピューティングハードウェア、ソフトウェア、そしてそれらを支える電力や建設作業はすべて、GDPにおける投資としてカウントされます。

segments.src: This spending can lift the headline figure noticeably.
segments.tr: この支出は、ヘッドライン数値を著しく押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: It is also concentrated in a relatively small number of companies and industries.
segments.tr: また、これは比較的少数の企業や業界に集中しています。

segments.src: A boom in server and data-center building can raise GDP without immediately changing the experience of a typical worker or renter.
segments.tr: サーバーやデータセンター建設のブームは、一般的な労働者や賃貸住宅居住者の生活を即座に変えることなく、GDPを押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: ### Trade
segments.tr: ### 貿易

segments.src: Net exports are one of the more volatile pieces of the report.
segments.tr: 純輸出は、レポートの中で最も変動の激しい要素の一つです。

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP and exports add to it.
segments.tr: 輸入はGDPから差し引かれ、輸出はGDPに加算されます。

segments.src: Swings in shipping, tariffs, inventory decisions and timing can move this component sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: 輸送、関税、在庫決定、タイミングの変動は、この構成要素を四半期ごとに大きく動かす可能性があります。

segments.src: A big shift in trade can make the headline number look stronger or weaker than the underlying demand.
segments.tr: 貿易の大きな変化は、ヘッドライン数値を実際の需要よりも強く、あるいは弱く見せることがあります。

segments.src: For that reason, many economists also watch measures that strip out trade and inventories to get a cleaner read on domestic demand.
segments.tr: そのため、多くの経済学者は、国内需要をより正確に把握するために、貿易と在庫を除いた指標も注視しています。

segments.src: ### Government and Inventories
segments.tr: ### 政府および在庫

segments.src: Government spending and changes in business inventories also contribute.
segments.tr: 政府支出と企業在庫の変化も寄与しています。

segments.src: Inventory swings in particular tend to reverse, so they can flatter one quarter and drag on the next.
segments.tr: 特に在庫の変動は反転する傾向があるため、ある四半期には数値を押し上げ、次の四半期には押し下げる要因となる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Why It Can Still Feel Slower
segments.tr: ## なぜ依然として低迷を感じるのか

segments.src: If output is rising at a healthy clip, why do so many people feel stuck?
segments.tr: 生産が健全なペースで上昇しているなら、なぜ多くの人々が行き詰まりを感じるのでしょうか？

segments.src: Several explanations are commonly offered by economists.
segments.tr: 経済学者によって、いくつかの説明が一般的に提示されています。

segments.src: Prices rise even when inflation cools.** Inflation measures how fast prices increase.
segments.tr: インフレが落ち着いても価格は上昇する。** インフレは価格が上昇する速さを測定するものです。

segments.src: A slowing rate does not mean prices fall.
segments.tr: 上昇率が鈍化したからといって、価格が下がるわけではありません。

segments.src: If the cost of food, housing or insurance jumped in earlier years, those higher levels remain.
segments.tr: 食料品、住宅、保険のコストが過去数年間に急騰した場合、その高い水準は維持されます。

segments.src: Households tend to judge the economy by the prices they see now, not by the pace of change.
segments.tr: 家計は、変化のペースではなく、今見ている価格で経済を判断する傾向があります。

segments.src: Essentials weigh more than averages suggest.** Official inflation gauges average across many goods.
segments.tr: 必需品は平均値が示唆するよりも重くのしかかる。** 公式のインフレ指標は、多くの商品の平均をとっています。

segments.src: A household that spends a large share of its income on rent, groceries, childcare or health care may experience its own inflation rate as higher than the average.
segments.tr: 所得の大部分を家賃、食料品、育児、医療に費やす世帯は、自分たちが経験するインフレ率が平均よりも高いと感じるかもしれません。

segments.src: Borrowing remains expensive.** Even if interest rates have eased from their peaks, mortgage, auto and credit-card costs can be well above where they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: 借入コストは依然として高い。** 金利がピークから低下したとしても、住宅ローン、自動車ローン、クレジットカードのコストは、数年前よりもはるかに高い可能性があります。

segments.src: That limits what many households can afford, whatever the national growth rate says.
segments.tr: それが、国の成長率がどうであれ、多くの世帯が負担できる範囲を制限しています。

segments.src: Growth is not evenly shared.** An economy can expand while gains flow mostly to business owners, investors and higher earners.
segments.tr: 成長は均等に分配されない。** 経済は拡大しても、その利益が主に事業主、投資家、高所得者に流れることがあります。

segments.src: Wage growth that merely keeps pace with prices leaves little sense of progress.
segments.tr: 物価上昇に追いつくだけの賃金上昇では、進歩の実感はほとんど得られません。

segments.src: Jobs and confidence are separate from output.** Growth can be strong while hiring slows or workers worry about job security.
segments.tr: 雇用と信頼感は生産とは別物である。** 成長が堅調でも、採用が鈍化したり、労働者が雇用の安定を心配したりすることはあります。

segments.src: Perceptions of the labor market often shape sentiment more than GDP does.
segments.tr: 労働市場に対する認識は、GDPよりもセンチメント（心理）を形成することがよくあります。

segments.src: GDP is not a measure of well-being.** It counts production, not savings, debt, housing affordability or financial stress.
segments.tr: GDPは幸福度の尺度ではない。** それは生産をカウントするものであり、貯蓄、負債、住宅の購入可能性、経済的ストレスをカウントするものではありません。

segments.src: A country can post strong GDP while many individuals feel squeezed.
segments.tr: 国が強力なGDPを記録しても、多くの個人が苦しいと感じることはあり得ます。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべきこと

segments.src: A single quarter does not settle the question.
segments.tr: 単一の四半期だけで結論が出るわけではありません。

segments.src: These indicators can help put the 3.4% figure in context:
segments.tr: 以下の指標は、3.4%という数値を文脈の中で理解するのに役立ちます：

segments.src: - **Revisions to the GDP estimate**, which can change the story.
segments.tr: - **GDP推計の修正**。物語を変える可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Real disposable income**, meaning income after taxes and inflation, which says more about household capacity than GDP does.
segments.tr: - **実質可処分所得**。税金とインフレを差し引いた後の所得であり、GDPよりも家計の能力について多くを物語ります。

segments.src: - **Wage growth compared with price growth**, since the gap between the two determines whether paychecks stretch further.
segments.tr: - **賃金上昇率と物価上昇率の比較**。両者のギャップが、給与がより多くの生活費をカバーできるかを決定するためです。

segments.src: - **Labor market data**, including hiring, unemployment and job openings.
segments.tr: - **労働市場データ**。採用、失業、求人数など。

segments.src: - **Business investment outside the AI sector**, to see whether growth is broad or narrow.
segments.tr: - **AIセクター以外の企業投資**。成長が広範囲か、それとも限定的かを確認するため。

segments.src: - **Consumer sentiment surveys**, which capture how people feel, not only what they spend.
segments.tr: - **消費者センチメント調査**。人々が何を支出するかだけでなく、どう感じているかを捉えます。

segments.src: ## A Practical Takeaway for Households
segments.tr: ## 家計にとっての実践的な教訓

segments.src: National statistics are useful for understanding the economy's direction.
segments.tr: 国の統計は、経済の方向性を理解するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: They are a poor guide to your own situation.
segments.tr: しかし、あなた自身の状況を知るための良いガイドではありません。

segments.src: A few general habits can help you separate the headlines from your own finances:
segments.tr: ヘッドラインとあなた自身の家計を切り離すために、いくつかの一般的な習慣が役立ちます：

segments.src: - Track your own budget, especially the categories that have risen fastest.
segments.tr: - 自分の予算を追跡する。特に最も上昇しているカテゴリーに注目してください。

segments.src: - Compare your income growth with the prices you actually pay.
segments.tr: - 自分の所得の伸びと、実際に支払っている価格を比較する。

segments.src: - Review variable-rate debt and think about what a change in rates would mean for you.
segments.tr: - 変動金利の負債を見直し、金利の変化が自分にとって何を意味するかを考える。

segments.src: - Keep an emergency cushion if you can, since a strong economy does not guarantee job stability.
segments.tr: - 可能であれば緊急時の備えを維持する。経済が堅調であっても雇用の安定は保証されないためです。

segments.src: - Treat any single data release as one data point, not a forecast.
segments.tr: - 単一のデータ発表を予測ではなく、一つのデータポイントとして扱う。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A 3.4% annualized growth rate points to an economy with real momentum, helped by consumer spending, heavy AI-related investment and shifts in trade.
segments.tr: 3.4%の年率成長率は、個人消費、巨額のAI関連投資、貿易の変動に支えられた、真の勢いを持つ経済を示しています。

segments.src: But GDP measures total output.
segments.tr: しかし、GDPは総生産を測定するものです。

segments.src: It does not measure how comfortable families feel after paying for housing, food and debt.
segments.tr: 住宅、食料、負債の支払いを終えた後に家族がどれだけ快適に感じているかを測定するものではありません。

segments.src: The gap between a strong headline and a tight household budget is not a contradiction.
segments.tr: 強力なヘッドラインと厳しい家計の間のギャップは、矛盾ではありません。

segments.src: It reflects the difference between how much an economy produces and how that production, and the price of living, show up in daily life.
segments.tr: それは、経済がどれだけ生産するかということと、その生産や生活コストが日常生活にどのように現れるかということの間の違いを反映しているのです。

de.title: 3,4% Wachstum, warum fühlt es sich also langsamer an? Der Bericht zum BIP des dritten Quartals

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Die US-

segments.src: economy grew at a 3.4% annualized rate in the third quarter, up from 2.2% in the second.
segments.tr: Wirtschaft wuchs im dritten Quartal mit einer annualisierten Rate von 3,4%, nach 2,2% im zweiten.

segments.src: By the usual yardsticks, that is a solid number.
segments.tr: Nach den üblichen Maßstäben ist das ein solider Wert.

segments.src: Yet plenty of households say they feel no stronger, because grocery bills, rent, insurance and borrowing costs still weigh on their budgets.
segments.tr: Dennoch sagen viele Haushalte, sie fühlten sich nicht stärker, weil Lebensmittelrechnungen, Miete, Versicherungen und Kreditkosten ihre Budgets weiterhin belasten.

segments.src: Both things can be true.
segments.tr: Beides kann wahr sein.

segments.src: GDP and a family's finances measure different things.
segments.tr: Das BIP und die Finanzen einer Familie messen unterschiedliche Dinge.

segments.src: This article looks at what the headline figure captures, what tends to drive it, and why it can diverge from everyday experience.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel beleuchtet, was die Schlagzeilenzahl erfasst, was sie antreibt und warum sie von der Alltagserfahrung abweichen kann.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur zu allgemeinen Informationszwecken.
